title: Survivor's Delight AFC
description: adds cabinet blocks for ArborFirmaCraft wood types
body:
Survivor's Delight AFC is a compatibility add-on that adds cabinet blocks for ArborFirmaCraft wood types. These cabinets behave like the cabinets from Survivor's Delight, including support for treatment-based food preservation.


Some AFC wood variants reuse cabinet models from Farmer's Delight as their appearance is close to vanilla wood, while the remaining variants include newly drawn block models to better match their own wood textures.


This mod is intended for TerraFirmaCraft-based modpacks that use Survivor's Delight and ArborFirmaCraft together, making AFC wood types feel more complete and consistent within the Survivor's Delight storage system.
